to: XT90-S male (re-terminated from EC5)
notes: Cut the EC5 off; strip 6 mm; tin; solder red to +; shrink; polarity check with a meter before the first plug-in
source: C0_BOM.csv (EC5 note); results.json C0.sized.I_trans; hardware-spec J19

to: CoreWing F405 Wing V2 PDB BAT+ / BAT- pads
termination: solder to pads; fit the included 35 V 470 uF capacitor across BAT+/BAT-
notes: XT90-S is the physical disconnect (R20); plugged in last

to: XT60H female at the wing root (one per ESC)
notes: Route out of the pod top beside the saddle tabs; label FR/RL/FL/RR; zip-tie to P24 anchors

to: SoloGood 45A ESC input leads
termination: solder to the ESC input pads/leads + shrink
notes: 6 x 6 mm channel in the wing lower surface from the root to the boom station (353.7 mm), then along the boom underside and up to the ESC: front ESC on the boom side or top face in the prop wash between the front gear clamp and the front wing clamp (180-240 mm from the boom tip, inside the 216 mm disc radius), rear ESC likewise between the rear wing clamp and the rear gear clamp (780-840 mm); tape over (BUILD-MANUAL 7.8; docs/research/thermal.md 6.4 item 4)
source: cad/params.txt zBoomPanel xFront xRear (stations calc EST)

to: X4110S motor leads (3)
conductor: motor's own leads (length —); extend with 14 AWG if short
notes: ESC on a 3 mm foam pad on the boom side or top face in the prop wash (BUILD-MANUAL 7.8); swap any two leads to reverse rotation after the direction test

to: SoloGood 45A ESC (pusher) in the pod tail
notes: Pusher ESC inside the pod ahead of the tail ring; service loop

to: X4110S pusher motor leads
notes: Solder before the cup is fitted (J12 screws go in from inside the cup)

to: EMAX ES3005HV (left aileron; wing pocket at 55 % c, 556.5 mm from the panel root)
notes: Servo rail set to 6 V on the FC (ES3005HV has no 5 V rating). Field disconnect at the wing root
source: firmware/vtol_c0.param SERVO1; firmware/README.md 4.1; cad/params.txt zServoPanel xServo

to: ES3005HV (right aileron)
notes: Set SERVO2_REVERSED after the direction check (README 7)

to: ES3005HV (elevator; standing on the stabiliser top at z -21 mm, x -842)
notes: Route: pod -> wing channel -> left boom underside -> stub -> tail clamp. Field disconnect at the left tail clamp

to: ES3005HV (left fin; on the stabiliser top at z -361 mm)
notes: Same bundle as S03 along the left boom

to: ES3005HV (right fin; stabiliser top at z +361 mm)
notes: Along the right boom; field disconnect at the right tail clamp. S11 is PWM-only: correct for a servo

to: ESC front-right (motor CCW seen from above)
connector: servo-lead 2 pins (no red wire to the rail)
notes: ArduPilot Quad X: M1 front-right CCW. DShot150, no ESC calibration. Motor-test button A

to: ESC rear-left (CCW)
notes: M2 rear-left CCW; motor-test button C

to: ESC front-left (CW)
notes: M3 front-left CW; motor-test button D

to: ESC rear-right (CW)
notes: M4 rear-right CW; motor-test button B. S10 (same group) must stay empty

to: pusher ESC
notes: DShot150; stopped in Q modes; air must blow aft

to: HGLRC M100-5883: GPS TX -> R5; GPS RX -> T5; SDA/SCL
connector: FC GPS connector (pin order differs from the pads: check the board image)
notes: Module on the printed pad P24 on the canopy top, arrow forward; 115200 UBX

from: FC TX6 / RX6 + 5 V + GND (SERIAL6 RCIN)
to: RadioMaster RP3 V2: receiver TX -> RX6; receiver RX -> TX6
notes: Antennas 90 deg apart taped inside the canopy; receiver failsafe = no pulses

from: FC 5 V pad (5.2 V / 4 A BEC) + GND
to: NewBeeDrone BeeID v1.1: 5V and GND only (TX/RX NOT connected)
notes: Broadcast module only; nav GPS stays the HGLRC. Not the 4V5 USB rail. Foam tape on the canopy, clear of the GPS

from: FC I2C airspeed connector (SDA SCL 5V GND)
to: Holybro MS5525DSO board INSIDE the pod near the FC - CSB pin re-strapped to GND (I2C 0x77) BEFORE first power-up
notes: Ships at 0x76 = the board baro address on the same (only) I2C bus. Bench check: Messages shows 'MS5525[0]: Found on bus 0 addr 0x77' and the baro still reads altitude. Fallback: MS4525DO sensor-only + PT40 (ARSPD_TYPE 1)
source: firmware/README.md 4.3; firmware/vtol_c0.param ARSPD_TYPE; firmware/peripherals.md 4; docs/research/firmware.md 4 R8

to: PT40 pitot under the left wing (x -50 mm = 18 % c, tube centre 9.5 mm below the lower surface, z -1.0 m)
notes: Run in the wing channel beside S01; field disconnect at the root (2 tubes). If the kit tubing is short see Gaps G3
source: cad/params.txt pitotX pitotY pitotZ; hardware-spec J16 + CAD notes

to: servo rail S1-S11
notes: Select 6 V. Five ES3005HV at ~1.5 A peak each EST < 8 A. Never connect an ESC BEC red wire to the rail
Spare; the FC supplies 5.2 V 4 A and the servo rail. Use on the thrust stand to power the Nano if needed

from: CoreWing BLE/WiFi module on the USB extender connector
to: laptop (Mission Planner)
notes: Bench and field laptop link; a SiK radio on TELEM2/4 (SERIAL4) is reserved, not bought
